name: Mood trends

modules.build: TopBar title 'Mood', actions 'log help'; SegmentedTabs row '[7D] [30D] [90D locked] [1Y locked]'
GlassStatCard hero r40, `--glow-you` orange glow, Overline 'TODAY FEELS', Display 34 '6 / 10', italic Newsreader 'steady', ChipProvenance 'via check-in · Jul 7'
SafetyResourceCard solid #211008 no glow, title 'Crisis resources', body 'Call, text, or view local help'
TrendChart solid #211008 (data-dense, not glass), title 'Mood trend', axes 8/5/2, Mon-Sun; orange line real check-in, dashed purple estimated context, green markers journal; default state

CIAInsightCard purple-tinted glass (glow-cia), copy 'CIA: mood has been higher on journal days in this window.', ChipProvenance 'Evidence: 4 check-ins, 3 entries', BtnPrimary 'Discuss patterns with CIA'

belowFold: ConsentCard: mood, journal, voice notes, health context, journal-tone analysis, CIA inference opt-in/opt-out/revoke/export/delete
trustControls: Crisis resources from top help and SafetyResourceCard
Mood, journal, voice notes, health context, journal-tone analysis, and CIA inference expose opt-in, opt-out, revoke, export, and delete in the evidence sheet
Log sheet includes skip option and support copy without pressure
notes: 90D, 1Y, advanced correlations, and CIA pattern handoff use PaywallLock; lock cannot obscure crisis access
Sparse dots render without connecting line until enough data (at least 3 check-ins)
Reduced motion renders full chart immediately, no draw-in animation
CTA routes: mood logging to /wellbeing/emotional-checkin, discussion to /ai-coach, source links to health settings
